title: Status line
summary: Shows account, model, effort, context, usage limits and folder, and writes the usage files that away mode reads.
details: A line under your prompt shows the active account, model and effort, context used, transcript size and compaction count, your 5-hour and weekly usage limits and the current folder. It helps you see which account you are on and how much of a limit you have used. It installs as a settings.json statusLine entry that runs bash ~/.claude/statusline.sh after each answer and writes small usage and cache files, including the usage files away mode reads; without jq a weaker fallback parser is used.

values.ask: Your Claude login email, or a glob such as *@company.com

user_steps: Install jq for the best status line (winget install --exact jqlang.jq); without it a weaker fallback parser is used.
risk: Runs after each answer and writes small usage and cache files in the Claude config folder. No network.
